messages:
Marie (Security PM): Quick check — SOC2 fieldwork requested a live demo of KMS/HSM rotation + auditlog chain. Can we get a fieldwork slot next week?
Daniel (KMS Owner): I can present rotation proof but need clarity on what artifacts auditors want (signed blobs, rotation logs, attestation).
Sasha (SRE): Are auditors asking for 90d retention for production logs? Need to confirm retention window before pulling samples.
Alex (Infra): From the ask earlier: 90d for prod, 30d for staging. Also they want one cross-region failover example in the logs.
Marie (Security PM): OK — @Daniel you'll own runbook + signed blob sample. @Sasha please pull a sample that includes cross-region fallback. @Alex can infra confirm ingestion mapping of cloudtrail->auditflow?
Daniel (KMS Owner): I have a draft runbook at https://redwood.internal/docs/keystore-rotation-draft — will finalize. Planning to include: rotation timeline, signer chain verify, and a CSV of rotation events.
Sasha (SRE): On it. Question: should sample logs be redacted or full? Auditors prefer original with PII redacted. I'll redact agent IDs.
Alex (Infra): eng-oncall — can you validate the auditflow mapping? Staging mapping currently drops region metadata which breaks the cross-region example.
eng-oncall: Looking now. Reconfiguring the mapping to include region tag, will post results in ~20m.
Marie (Security PM): Audit-bot reminder: evidence cutoff is 2025-06-12 17:00 UTC. We need preflight before then.
audit-bot: Reminder: fieldwork evidence deadline: 2025-06-12 17:00 UTC. Please attach artifacts to s3://evidence/soc2/keystore by deadline.
Daniel (KMS Owner): I'll upload rotation_proof_2025-05-28.csv and signed_blobs.tar.gz by 2025-06-06.
Sasha (SRE): Uploading sample logs now: s3://evidence/soc2/keystore/log-sample-2025-05-27.csv (redacted). Includes a cross-region failover entry at line ~652.
Alex (Infra): Confirmed: ingestion fix deployed. Cloudtrail region field now flows through to auditflow. I updated INFRA-482 and left notes.
Marie (Security PM): Great. Proposed preflight demo: 2025-06-09 14:00 UTC (30m). Can presenters confirm?
Daniel (KMS Owner): I can present attestation and rotation chain.
Sasha (SRE): I'll cover the log sample and ingestion validation.
Alex (Infra): I'll standby for any infra questions.
Marie (Security PM): Action items: Daniel — finalize runbook + upload artifacts by 2025-06-06 (KMS-237). Sasha — confirm cross-region entry and EOD sanity check. eng-oncall/Alex — confirm ingestion is green and update INFRA-482. I'll schedule the preflight and invite auditors.
Daniel (KMS Owner): noted, will tag the runbook with OWNER: @Daniel and add links.
eng-oncall: Pipeline is green, pushed mapping fix, and added a test that asserts region tag presence. Will update INFRA-482 now.
Sasha (SRE): Quick FYI — I included a one-line grep example in the upload notes: `grep "failover" log-sample-2025-05-27.csv | head -n 5` to highlight cross-region lines.
Marie (Security PM): Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, ping me directly. Otherwise I'll proceed to lock the preflight slot and send calendar invites.
Alex (Infra): :+1:
Daniel (KMS Owner): :thumbsup:
Sasha (SRE): :thumbsup:
Marie (Security PM): Thanks team — keeping this thread for final upload confirmations.
